assignments.essential_function: Plan and coordinate month-end close tasks,dependencies,owners and review status.
Organize period-end close tasks, dependencies, deadlines, journal-entry support and review checkpoints.

review: Selected unchanged for month-end close planning and tracking. Detailed pre-close and T+1–T+5 sequence, dependencies, owners, blockers, review gates and retrospective. Authored scope includes posting,locking periods and distributing reporting packages; the redesigned role accepts that full scope rather than forbidding it through new instructions. User-invocable:false means supporting knowledge rather than a directly registered command. No material arithmetic defect found in inspected instructions; runtime untested.
native_prerequisites: Close calendar,accounting policies,task owners and current task status.
Accounting system access for system actions if requested; otherwise the documented calendar/status/checklist work uses supplied inputs.
Original source requires qualified financial-professional review of close activities.
Original plugin directory and any CONNECTORS.md preserved; optional connected modes require the actual named service capabilities.
